lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Uh, so he's definitely still stronger than the both of us, right?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Well, your oldest brat's still stronger, so where's he?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: What? Then who did you grab?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: You had two grabs. Dende, come on — the magic man I get. But why that oaf?

lines.speaker: Hercule
lines.text: You know, I can hear you.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Look, I panicked, and I grabbed the Dragon Balls, okay?

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: Oh, so that's how you see me.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Well, great. We have Dragon Balls. Now we just have to live long enough to use them.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Oh, come on. I'm sure we'll be—

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I see you for more than your balls.
